page.notes: Arabic passages are transcribed as printed; the bracketed fragments and the final line of Arabic are the most uncertain and should be checked against the scan. "Bashar" and "cuiùs" are doubtful readings. Italic boundaries in the Latin are approximate. The marginal note "* Me subinde visere." belongs to the asterisk in the text. The note "Al Jannab." stands in the right margin at the last line; no reference mark is visible for it.
